own_solution.law: Newton's second law for each block plus rotational dynamics of the pulley (I = M R^2 / 2, no slip a = alpha R): a = (m2 - m1) g / (m1 + m2 + M/2)

T4B03.regime: both string tensions (about 35.9 N and 38.1 N) are below the 200 N breaking limit

notes: a = (5 - 3)*9.8/(3 + 5 + 1) = 19.6/9 = 2.1778 m/s^2. Tensions: T_left = 3(9.8 + 2.1778) = 35.93 N, T_right = 5(9.8 - 2.1778) = 38.11 N, both far below 200 N. With 0.8 kg added to the left block: a = (5 - 3.8)*9.8/(3.8 + 5 + 1) = 11.76/9.8 = 1.2 m/s^2 (right side still heavier, direction unchanged). The radius appears in torque (T2 - T1) R = I alpha with I = M R^2/2 and a = alpha R, and cancels. Paired sentences state the same values (0.8 kg; 12 cm; 200 N). TA9DB has slightly awkward wording ('measures, from its axle to its rim, 12 cm') but means the radius. A frictionless axle is not stated but is the standard implicit assumption.
